systemSummary.name: Argo Workflows Kubernetes-Native Orchestration Engine
systemSummary.description: Container-native workflow orchestrator for Kubernetes modeling workflows as DAGs and Steps, executing steps as Pods with injected argoexec sidecars, and reconciling state via Kubernetes custom resource controllers.

workflowController.description: Core Kubernetes Custom Resource controller reconciling Workflow and Pod resources via informers.

operatorEngine.description: Per-workflow reconciliation state machine evaluating templates, DAGs, steps, and pod lifecycles.

argoexecSidecar.description: Injected pod init and wait container managing artifact hydration, exit code harvesting, and output capture.

syncManager.description: ConfigMap and database-backed semaphore/mutex concurrency coordination subsystem.

durableExecutionModel.crReconciliation: Workflows are defined as Kubernetes Workflow CRDs. WorkflowController watches CRD and Pod events via informers and reconciles state in level-triggered loops using optimistic ResourceVersion locking.
durableExecutionModel.podExecution: Each task node is dispatched as a Kubernetes Pod. An argoexec init container pulls input artifacts; an argoexec wait container monitors the user container, saves output parameters/artifacts, and posts completion annotations.
durableExecutionModel.dagStepEvaluation: DAGs and Steps evaluate task dependencies (depends logic, when expressions) and fan out parallel iterations (withItems, withParam).
durableExecutionModel.synchronization: Semaphores and mutexes coordinate cross-workflow concurrency limits via ConfigMaps.
durableExecutionModel.archival: Completed workflows are offloaded to SQL databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL) to avoid etcd storage limits.
